Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class PlayerRegenComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.PlayerRegenComponent
public class PlayerRegenComponent extends Component
Heals the owning entity gradually while a regeneration potion is active.

Regeneration is not a stat multiplier, so it is kept out of PlayerBuffComponent and handled here instead: health is restored one tick at a time until the duration runs out. Ticking is driven by GameTime rather than by counting frames, matching how buffs are timed, so a slow frame heals the ticks it skipped instead of losing them.

The same "strongest wins" rule as buffs applies: a stronger potion replaces a weaker regeneration, and a weaker one is rejected so ConsumableUseComponent leaves it in the inventory.

Healing is capped at the entity's maximum health, which is read from ConsumableUseComponent because CombatStatsComponent is shared with other teams and has no maximum health field.

    • startRegen

      public boolean startRegen(int healPerTick, float durationSeconds)
      Starts regenerating health, replacing any weaker regeneration already running.

      A regeneration is allowed at full health: the healing arrives over several seconds, so it is still worth drinking before a fight rather than being wasted.

      Parameters:
      healPerTick - health restored each tick; must be > 0
      durationSeconds - how long regeneration lasts, in seconds; must be > 0
      Returns:
      true if regeneration started
